title: Matrix exponent junta solver exponent
statement: For a positive rational exponent $\omega$ and a natural number $k$, define the matrix exponent junta solver exponent to be $\omega$ multiplied by $k$ minus the matrix exponent junta cutoff at $\omega$ and $k$; explicitly, $\omega\bigl(k-\operatorname{cutoff}(\omega,k)\bigr)$.
